summary: Added test/gate-journal.test.js — 34 assertions, all passing. Tests: (1) a gated /search with no notes writes exactly one JSONL row to .graph/gate-journal.jsonl with ts (ISO), decision, top1 (number), embedModel='Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2', task_key present, plus workspace/query/reason/margin/gap/locality/topType/via fields; (2) explicit ?task_key= is captured in the row; (3) INJECT path journals correctly (skipped without cached MiniLM, ran and verified row appended when model available); (4) chmod-based fail-open test confirms journal write failure does not break the HTTP response. Daemon change (journal appended at daemon.js:1806-1817) was already in tree — confirmed correct. Journal goes live at next gated daemon restart.

subject: Gate-decision journal: persist every gate verdict with raw features
description: In daemon.js's gated-search path (~line 1777-1780, where gateTask() runs), append every gate verdict — INJECT and ABSTAIN both — as one JSONL row to .graph/gate-journal.jsonl. Row schema: { ts, workspace, query, task_key (if provided on the request), decision, reason, top1, margin, gap, locality, topType, topKey, via, embedModel }. embedModel = version stamp of the embedding model in use (see lib/embed.js — hardcode the current model id string if no programmatic id exists). Append must be fail-open: a journal write error must never break the search response (wrap in try/catch, swallow). No rotation, no config, no speculative features — append-only JSONL, ~15-25 lines total. Add one test (extend test/context-gate-route.test.js or a new small file) asserting a gated call appends a parseable row with the expected fields, covering both an abstain and (if easily arrangeable) an inject. Do NOT restart the daemon — code goes live on next gated restart; note that in the completion summary. Purpose (context): this journal is the training-data flywheel for the learned context gate — labels are joined later from task outcomes, so abstain rows and raw features are mandatory (see notes note-mqasdxx0tnt and note-mqaslontp50).
